> [!warning] Contradiction: partial capture and amount-update eligibility
> The 2026-11-02 Checkout API v72 `POST /payments/{paymentPspReference}/amountUpdates` page says only authorised amounts not yet captured can be updated (raw line 9). The 2026-09-15 pre-authorisation guide permits an adjustment after the first partial capture when Support has enabled multiple partial captures (guide raw lines 1032-1040). Keep this endpoint-level restriction and the conditional guide exception distinct; the documents do not resolve their overlap. [[source-adyen-api-explorer-checkout-latest-post-payments-paymentpspreference-amountupdates]]
warnings: Add reciprocal contradiction warning to this existing concept; the source page contains its counterpart. Guide support at raw/adyen/docs/online-payments/adjust-authorisation/adjust-with-preauth/2026-09-15.md lines 1032-1040.
